about.company: NAVIAR Consult is an advisory practice for organisations that want a clearer practice for follow-up, workplace accommodation and work attendance. We help HR and managers understand where the process stalls, clarify responsibility and turn findings into concrete actions with an owner and a time for evaluation.
about.intro: I work at the intersection of leadership support, workplace accommodation and work attendance. NAVIAR was developed to make complex follow-up situations more understandable and more workable in practice.
about.name: Betül Öner
about.photo_alt: Betül Öner, founder of NAVIAR Consult
about.title: Experience from both sides of the table.
about.lead: I have more than 30 years of work experience, including nearly 20 years in the Norwegian labour and welfare administration — with work-oriented follow-up, sickness-absence follow-up, employer dialogue and case management under the National Insurance Act.
about.bio: I hold a Master of Public Administration (MPA) in public management and financial governance, and have worked as an adviser at several local offices of the public labour and welfare administration, in an employer services unit and as an HR adviser in a hospital. I have sat in dialogue meetings with employee, manager and doctor, worked with inclusive-workplace (IA) measures and leadership support — and have a background in quality management and financial governance.
about.why: Most organisations do not lack will; they lack a shared, clear practice for how work is accommodated and followed up. NAVIAR gives that practice a language and a structure.
about.how: A limited mandate, written agreements and a few, prioritised actions. Observation, interpretation and open questions are kept apart — and everything that is agreed is written down.
about.not: Medical, psychological or legal assessments, individual assessment of work capacity, or automated assessments of people. Such matters are referred to the right professionals.
about.f2: Nearly 20 years in the labour and welfare administration
about.f3: Local offices, employer services and hospital HR
about.f4: Dialogue meetings, IA work and leadership support

insights.title: Three short notes from practice.

n1.t: Talk about work — not about diagnosis.
n1.d: A follow-up conversation is safer for both parties when it is about tasks, capacity and accommodation. The employer cannot demand a diagnosis; what is needed is information about what the employee can do. Write down what is agreed — with an owner and a date.
n1.src: Based on the Norwegian Data Protection Authority's guidance on privacy in the workplace

n2.t: An action without an evaluation date is an intention.
n2.d: Most actions do not fail for lack of will, but because nobody agreed when they would be assessed. Set the evaluation date when the action is agreed — not afterwards. Then the follow-up plan becomes a working document, not a form.
n2.src: Based on the employer's duty to prepare a follow-up plan (Working Environment Act § 4-6)

n3.t: Uneven practice is the hidden cost.
n3.d: When managers follow up differently, HR has to tidy up afterwards — and the same questions keep coming back. A shared structure gives managers confidence and employees predictability, regardless of who the manager is.
n3.src: Experience from employer follow-up and HR advisory work

insights.note: More notes are published continuously. Each note states its source and separates regulation, interpretation and practical advice.

privacy.s2t: What we process on the website
privacy.s2: The website uses no cookies for analytics or tracking and has no forms. Your language choice is stored locally in your browser (localStorage) and is not sent to us. The website is delivered by a hosting provider that may keep technical logs (IP address, time, requested page) for a short period for operations and security. Such logs may be processed outside the EEA on the basis of the EU standard contractual clauses.
privacy.s3: If you send an email, we process your name, email address, organisation, role and the content of your enquiry in order to reply and clarify whether NAVIAR Start fits. privacy.s5: Enquiries are kept while the dialogue is ongoing and then for up to 12 months, unless an agreement is made. Data is not shared with third parties for marketing. Email and hosting providers process data on our behalf under a data processing agreement.
privacy.s6: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction and data portability, and the right to object to processing based on legitimate interest. Contact personvern@naviarconsult.com. You may also complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet).
privacy.s7: In a NAVIAR Start engagement the client organisation is the data controller. Roles, information boundaries and any data processing agreement are clarified in writing before the start. NAVIAR does not collect health information about employees.

privacy.a: As little as possible. We ask about work, tasks and accommodation — not about diagnoses. Only agreed actions, responsibilities and dates go into the plan, and NAVIAR does not collect health information.

partner.a: Ongoing implementation and leadership support once the need, mandate and capacity have been documented. Intake opens later.

journey.q: Work presence and Work in practice?

standard.a: Four fixed elements in everything we deliver: mandate, responsibility, actions and evaluation. The same structure regardless of the engagement.
